page.layout: Two printed pages. Left page: running head and page number at top, one column of italic verse centred on the page, a decorative woodcut initial below it, and the catchword "COROL-" at the right below the verse. Right page: running head at top, text in one column cut off at the right edge of the scan, with a decorative initial at the head of the column. Faint show-through from the reverse side is left out.
page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so each line shows only its first letters; the cut-off ends are not legible and are marked [?]. The left-hand verse is set in italic. The woodcut initial and ornament are not text. Faint show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed. The catchword COROL- is at the foot of the left page. The right running head is cut off after "COROL".
